name: Motor run-feedback discrepancy
summary: Detects disagreement between the requested motor run state and its defined feedback.
description: Detects disagreement between the requested motor run state and its defined feedback. A motor feeder combines switching, motor protection and an operating command. Starting permission, running feedback and protection trip are different signals even where one relay or controller processes all of them.

In a switchroom motor-control panel, a ventilation motor can receive an automatic start request while a local selector and the motor protection determine whether the feeder is available. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Run command and feedback” at the input and “Run mismatch alarm” at the output. Feedback may come from contactor or process sensing.
